role: Bookings officer for a charitable village hall trust, reviewing each hire request before it is confirmed, held or turned away
setting: A small hall trust runs a main hall, a committee room and a kitchen annexe for private parties, clubs, classes and fundraisers. Requests arrive through an online form that builds a structured record from the applicant's account, the event details, the requested slot, uploaded documents, payment ledger and past hire history. The officer works through one request at a time, decides what happens to it, what staffing the hall must provide on the day, and how complete and well-sized it is. Records hold no free text; every judgement rests on fields, dates, counts and cross-section comparisons.

cover_valid.instructions: Public liability cover is in force for the whole event date.

disposition.instructions: What should the bookings officer do with this request?

criteria.decline: Unresolved arrears or unsettled damage claim bars this hirer outright.
criteria.hold_for_docs: Hirer eligible and slot free, but required documents incomplete.
criteria.offer_alternative: Hirer eligible but requested slot clashes with a firm booking.
criteria.approve_conditional: Slot free, documents supplied; approval needs caps, staffing or verification.
criteria.approve: Slot free, documents verified, no caps or extra staffing required.

supervision.instructions: What level of caretaker presence should the hall arrange?

criteria.self_access: Trusted regular hirer collects key; no staff attend at all.
criteria.open_and_lock: Caretaker unlocks and locks up only; no cover during event.
criteria.on_call: Caretaker reachable by phone, able to attend within minutes.
criteria.on_site: Caretaker remains on the premises for the whole hire.

doc_completeness.instructions: How complete is the required documentation for this event?
criteria: None: no required document has been uploaded.
Partial: some uploaded, at least one absent or expired.
Unverified: all uploaded and in date, one or more unverified.
Complete: all uploaded, in date and office-verified.

attendance_load.instructions: How does expected attendance compare with the room's capacity?
criteria: Attendance below half of room capacity
Attendance from half to under 80% of capacity
Attendance from 80% up to full capacity
Attendance above capacity by no more than 10%
Attendance exceeds capacity by more than 10%

factors.name: event_type
factors.description: Kind of hire; drives which documents are required (alcohol authorisation, safeguarding policy, food hygiene certificate) and the baseline staffing need.

factors.name: attendance_ratio
factors.description: Expected attendance divided by the capacity of the requested room; about a fifth of records sit within two percentage points of 50%, 80%, 100% or 110% so judges may split.

factors.name: insurance_state
factors.description: Source and validity of public liability cover: own certificate valid, own certificate expiring before the event, no certificate, hall hirer scheme opted into with premium paid, or opted in but premium unpaid.

factors.name: other_docs_missing
factors.description: Number of required non-insurance documents (alcohol authorisation, safeguarding policy, food hygiene certificate) absent, null-dated or expired before the event; capped by how many the event actually requires.

factors.name: docs_unverified
factors.description: At least one uploaded, in-date document has verified_on null, meaning the office has not yet checked it.

factors.name: verification_out_of_order
factors.description: A document's verified_on date precedes its uploaded_on date, or the deposit_paid_on precedes request_received; an out-of-order verification must be treated as unverified.

factors.name: slot_clash
factors.description: Overlap with another booking in the same room and time window: none, firm (confirmed) clash, provisional clash whose hold has already expired, or provisional clash still live.

factors.name: hirer_track_record
factors.description: Applicant's history with the hall: first-time hirer, regular hirer with no incidents, or regular hirer with at least one recorded damage or overstay incident.

factors.name: incident_settled
factors.description: Mitigation for a past incident: the damage claim has a settled_on date before the request date. Only meaningful when the hirer has an incident.

factors.name: arrears_state
factors.description: Overdue balance on the hirer's account: none, overdue with no plan, or overdue with an agreed payment plan and no missed instalments.

factors.name: alcohol_late_finish
factors.description: Whether alcohol is served and whether the event ends after 23:00, the hall's standard closing time.

factors.name: external_bar_staffed
factors.description: Mitigation for alcohol: an external licensed bar operator supplies its own staff (staff_count at least 2). Only meaningful when alcohol is served.

factors.name: days_to_event
factors.description: Days between request_received and the event date; short lead times make an unverified document harder to resolve and appear as decoy urgency.

sections.name: applicant
sections.description: Hirer account: id, hirer_type, first_booking_date, hirer_scheme_opt_in.

sections.name: event
sections.description: Event details: category, expected_attendance, alcohol_served, bar_operator, finish_time, under_18s_present, catering.

sections.name: booking_slot
sections.description: Requested room, room_capacity, date, start, end, request_received and a clashes list.

sections.name: documents
sections.description: List of uploaded documents with doc_type, uploaded_on, expires_on, verified_on.

sections.name: payment
sections.description: hire_fee, deposit_due, deposit_paid_on, overdue_balance, payment_plan, scheme_premium_paid.

sections.name: history
sections.description: past_bookings_count and an incidents list with date, type, claim_amount, settled_on.

rendering_notes: event_type shows as event.category plus derived flags (under_18s_present true for children_party; catering 'hot_food' for some celebrations and fundraisers; alcohol_served from alcohol_late_finish). attendance_ratio is never shown; render event.expected_attendance and booking_slot.room_capacity as integers so the reader must divide. insurance_state appears as a documents entry of doc_type 'public_liability' (expires_on before booking_slot.date when expiring; entry absent when missing) or, for scheme cases, applicant.hirer_scheme_opt_in true with payment.scheme_premium_paid true or false and no certificate entry. cover_valid is true only for own_cert_valid or hall_scheme_paid. Required non-insurance documents are not listed anywhere: the reader infers them (alcohol_authorisation if alcohol_served and bar_operator.type is 'self'; safeguarding_policy if under_18s_present; food_hygiene if catering is 'hot_food'); other_docs_missing renders as an absent entry, an entry with uploaded_on null, or expires_on before the event. docs_unverified renders as verified_on null; verification_out_of_order renders as verified_on earlier than uploaded_on, or deposit_paid_on earlier than request_received (a ledger decoy that does not by itself change disposition). slot_clash renders in booking_slot.clashes as entries with status 'confirmed' or 'provisional' and hold_expires; a lapsed provisional has hold_expires before request_received and does not block the slot; a live provisional is contested between hold and offer_alternative. Clashes on the same date but non-overlapping times are decoys. hirer_track_record renders via history.past_bookings_count (0 for first-time, with applicant.first_booking_date null) and history.incidents; incident_settled renders as settled_on date or null. arrears_state renders as payment.overdue_balance above 0 with payment_plan null or a plan object (agreed_on, instalments_missed 0). alcohol_late_finish renders via event.alcohol_served and event.finish_time; external_bar_staffed via event.bar_operator {type:'external', staff_count}. days_to_event is implied by request_received and booking_slot.date. Disposition precedence: unresolved arrears or unsettled incident claim gives decline; else firm or live clash gives offer_alternative; else any missing or expired document gives hold_for_docs; else unverified documents, attendance above capacity, or alcohol/late finish needing on_site or on_call staffing gives approve_conditional; otherwise approve. Supervision: on_site for both alcohol and late finish without external staffed bar, attendance above capacity, or unsettled incident; on_call for alcohol or late finish mitigated by external staff, or first-time hirer at 80% or more of capacity; self_access only for regular_clean hirers with neither alcohol nor late finish and attendance under 80%; open_and_lock otherwise. Decoys: hirer_type, hire_fee size, large past_bookings_count alongside an unsettled incident, room name, short lead time. No record may carry fields such as status, risk, recommended_action, docs_complete, supervision_level or capacity_percentage.
